content: Hosu apaune vayaꞌmo mago vekamo aipafiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vekamo ava gemae.
Apakaemo ani kotuꞌmo lakaeꞌa Gatalini vayaꞌmo neꞌmaiya aupilagamo uꞌa avaꞌyi huꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa sipifatiꞌmo emine neꞌegenoꞌaeꞌmo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo aipafiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vekamo kanolufilagatiꞌmo neꞌegeꞌa fotu huꞌnae.

Ani vekamo vayaꞌmo kiꞌa neꞌapataya yafaka kanolufilaga neꞌmaigeꞌapaeꞌmo mago vayaꞌmogimo uꞌa atafaugefe huꞌnayana afaꞌa oꞌatafauge seli nofitetiꞌmo kiꞌa ategefe huꞌnayana afaꞌa kiꞌa oꞌatege huꞌnaya vekae.

Mago vayaꞌmogimo muki afinaꞌae afinaꞌaeꞌmo aiyalateꞌmo hanikapu aiꞌa atege ayatalateꞌmo seli nofitetiꞌmo kiꞌa atege huꞌnayaꞌmonanafa seli nofiꞌmo alino kapalu aege hanikapumo aino lo aege huno maiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo afaꞌa yagaiꞌa oꞌateꞌnae.
Muki afinaꞌmo felugaꞌe haniꞌilagaꞌeꞌmo kanolufilagaꞌe avelegaꞌeꞌmo umenitata nehunoꞌaeꞌmo lusi kava huno kagegage nehunoꞌaeꞌmo agaiꞌa agufamo yafatetiꞌmo heno hatagauno maiꞌniye.

Agaemo afagitegatiꞌmo Yesuꞌmo agetenoꞌaeꞌmo nagu nagu huno eno aiyafiꞌmo aleꞌya faiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo alopa gefatiꞌmo mono hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Yesuo, huno, Hogote vekamo anaga vekamo Goti mafaꞌneꞌamogae, huno, nagaetegamo na agufa kavaꞌmo huka nategefeꞌmo neꞌane. Goti agiꞌaletiꞌmo kagoꞌya ataleteka hukaeꞌmo, kagafu kisiya yaꞌmo aliꞌna okamiguve, huka naha paiyo, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Hogoteno Yesuꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo, hosu aune neo, huno, aipafatiꞌmo emikeno, huno huꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo ani gemo huꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa, kagikamo ina lagae, huno afi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo lagaemo asole vayaꞌmo maiꞌnonaꞌmofeꞌmo nagiꞌnimo asole vayaꞌnae, huno ha paitenoꞌaeꞌmo,
kahao ke hovanagi afagitega alika laha faika olatalo, huno huge huge huno maiꞌniye.
Inagi asole afu anagaꞌmo aveleꞌmo neꞌa maiꞌnae.
Hosu apaune vayaꞌmogi, alika laha faitalegeta afu anagaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo haita maino, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.

Yesuꞌa, kanalenagi afaꞌa viyo, huno huꞌnigeꞌa hosu apaune vayaꞌmo aipafatiꞌmo emi eꞌa tu tauseniꞌa agufa afu anagaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo faleꞌa haiꞌnageꞌapaeꞌmo aulafifatiꞌmo nagu nagu huꞌa uꞌa lamiꞌa ani kotupiꞌmo asagauꞌa aiteꞌa aniꞌmo neteꞌa faliꞌnae.
Ani afuleꞌmo neꞌyagaiya vayaꞌmo apaune heꞌuꞌa taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa paige alu haopalega uꞌa hapa paige huꞌa hapa paiꞌnageꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo agesayafeꞌmo eꞌnae.

Apakaemo Yesutegamo eꞌa agayana hosu apaune vayaꞌmo aipafatiꞌmo alino hapafaitaleꞌniya vekamoꞌmo kukenamo alino vaiteno mopafiꞌmo fai maiꞌnigeno agesamo aino halo aiꞌnigeno maiꞌnigeꞌa eꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo koli huꞌnae.
Ani kavaꞌmo ageꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo aipafiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vekaeꞌmo ava gemo huge afu anagaꞌaifeꞌmo apava gemo huge huꞌa hapa paiꞌnae.
Hapa paiꞌnageꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo Yesufeꞌmo, kahao ke honanagi mani kotetiꞌmo ataleka uvo, huꞌa ha paiꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa sipifiꞌmo haiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo aipafatiꞌmo alino hapafaino apataleꞌniya vekamoꞌmo, kahao ke hove, huno, kagaeꞌeꞌmo ugesugi navalelika ugapiye, huno afi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo
Yesuꞌa, haꞌao, huno, vayakalegageꞌmo uka Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa lusi kava huno hau huno kateteno kaha maeꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huka hapa paiyo, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Ha paiꞌnigeno uno naya loleꞌa taonimo agiꞌamo Nekapolisi kotegamo umenitata huno Yesuꞌa lusi kava huno ha maeꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo aeno hakalo huno hapa paimale hapa paimale hulino uꞌnigeꞌa ani gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo hapau aiꞌnae.
Yailasi aꞌmafaꞌneꞌe mago kaita hauꞌniya a kanoꞌefeꞌmo anava gemo huꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa halate mugagayaga faligamo lakaenuno ani agiꞌnaleꞌmo maiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo eꞌa aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌnae.

Maiꞌnageno Yailasiꞌa Yu vayaꞌai monoteꞌmo neꞌyagaiya vekamoꞌa eno Yesuꞌmo agetenoꞌaeꞌmo aiyafiꞌmo agoꞌya faino maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo, kahao ke hove, huno, aꞌmafaꞌneꞌnimo aise afinaꞌmo ago faligefe huꞌnigeꞌnaeꞌmo huvanagi halate alagepa huno maisiyafeꞌmo eka agufaleꞌmo kayaꞌmo maleka ato, huno lokiya ge huno afi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo
Yesuꞌa agaeꞌeꞌmo uꞌniye. Neꞌvigeꞌapaeꞌmo faiꞌa ku aili ku aili huꞌa maleꞌa apaliniꞌa uꞌnae.
Mago a kanomo tuolofuꞌa kafugamo aiguꞌyaꞌmo hauge hauge huno maiꞌniya a kanomo maiꞌniye.
Agaemo alu lota vaya alu lota vayaꞌaitegamo uge uge huꞌniyana ha oꞌmaeꞌnageno lusi agafu kiꞌnigeno muki moniꞌamo ataleꞌniyana ha okeno magoꞌe huno hauge hauge huno maiꞌniye.

Agaemo Yesufeꞌmo ava gemo afitenoꞌaeꞌmo asole vayaꞌeꞌmo eno magokepi lokaelino neꞌenoꞌaeꞌmo, kukenaꞌaleꞌmo ame alisuvana aiguꞌyaꞌnimo alagi nahagegaiye, huno agesamo afiteno akamelegatiꞌmo eno kukenaꞌaleꞌmo ame aliꞌniye.
Ame neꞌaligenoꞌaeꞌmo aiguꞌyaꞌamo malage huno hageꞌnigeno agufafilagamo alino amalagino ageꞌniye.

Ame neꞌaligenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa ageyana agufafatiꞌmo himamuꞌamo ago uꞌnigeno ageꞌniye. Agetenoꞌaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌeꞌmo magokepi neꞌenoꞌaeꞌmo aino afe leno, ina laꞌmo kukenaꞌnileꞌmo ame aliꞌniye, huno apafi geꞌniye.
Apafi geꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogi huꞌapaeꞌmo, asole vayaꞌmogimo maleꞌa kapaliniꞌa neꞌvagi na kava higekaeꞌmo ina laꞌmo kukenaꞌnileꞌmo ame aliꞌniye, huka nehane, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa ame aliꞌniya vekamo agesiyafeꞌmo aulaga halino apakelinuneno huꞌniye.

Aulaga halino neꞌapakegenoꞌaeꞌmo ani a kanomoꞌa agufafilagamo afole aiꞌniya kavaꞌmo agetenoꞌaeꞌmo eno aiyafiꞌmo agoꞌya faiꞌneno koli huteno atete nehaigenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesufeꞌmo muki kavaꞌaeꞌmo lama ge huno ava gemo huno ha paiꞌniye.
Ani gemo ha paiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo, aꞌmafaꞌneo, huno, kagesa afika fatago huꞌnana kavakamoꞌa alino alagepa huno kateꞌniyanagi uka alagepa huka maigenoꞌao kaipamoꞌmo falu hino, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Ha nepaigeꞌapaeꞌmo mago vayaꞌmo Yailasiꞌa Yu vayaꞌai monoteꞌmo neꞌyagaiya vekamo notegatiꞌmo eꞌapaeꞌmo, aꞌmafaꞌnekamo ago faliꞌnigi na kava higeka tisa vekamo alaga haesiya yaꞌmo alika neꞌamine, huꞌa ha paiꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa ani gemo afitenoꞌaeꞌmo monote neꞌyagaiya vekaeꞌmo ha painoꞌaeꞌmo, koli osuka nagaefekeꞌmo kagesa afika fatago huvo, huno ha paiteno
muki vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, oꞌmetapa afaꞌa maiyo, huno hapa paiteno Pitaꞌagi Yemisiꞌagi Yemisi aganaꞌamo Yoniꞌagi huno apavalelino uꞌniye.
Monote neꞌyagaiya vekamo noteꞌmo uꞌa avaꞌyi huteꞌapaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa apakeyana ani vayaꞌmogi apano aeteꞌa faiyosago faiꞌa aviꞌya nehageno apakeꞌniye.
Agaemo nopiꞌmo nehainoꞌaeꞌmo, na kava higetapaeꞌmo lapano aetetapa aviꞌya nehae. Ani aꞌmafaꞌnemo ofaliꞌnifa afaꞌa au kaleno maiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌa kigi huꞌa ateꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌamo ago alino hapa faitalegeꞌa kumataga lamiꞌnae. Agaemo ani aꞌmafaꞌnemo itaꞌafoꞌalaꞌmoganimogi agaemo avagi huꞌa eꞌnaya vayanagi huno apavalelino ani aꞌmafaꞌnemo maleꞌnaya nopiꞌmo haiꞌnae.
Ayateꞌmo neꞌalinoꞌaeꞌmo, talita kumi, huno huꞌniye. Ani gemo aepaꞌamo haneꞌniyana aise aꞌmafaꞌneo, huꞌna, he tiyo, huꞌna kaha nepauve, huno huꞌniye.
Huno nehigenoꞌaeꞌmo malage huno he tino umenitata huꞌniye. Ani aꞌmafaꞌnemo tuolofuꞌa kafugamo maiꞌniya aꞌmafaꞌnemae. Umenitata huꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌa hapau aiꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa lokiya gemo huno hapa paitenoꞌaeꞌmo, mago vayaꞌaifeꞌmo utapa hapa opaiyo, huno ha paiteno, mago neꞌyaꞌmo alitapa amiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
